about: The words of Restart the task on the owner's pending-evidence row (ownerAction RESTART_TASK,
docs/evidence-always-has-an-addressee-design.md section 3, D2 = A). One copy table all three clients
are proved against: the web reads this file in `EvidenceRestartAction.test.tsx`, OrbitKit and the
Android client read it in their own copy-parity tests, so the browser, the Mac and the phone say the
same words. `refusalCode` is the server's 409 code for a press that is no longer offered.

copy.explanation: No run of this task is live to submit it again, and no coordinator was told to act on it. Restart the task and a new run will submit evidence against the standard it is held to now.
copy.started: Restarted: a new run will submit the evidence again.
copy.stale: Not restarted: this row is out of date
